name: John Mitchell
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: An Irish lightweight from Cork ('The Cork Horse', 11-3, age 31), based in the UAE, signed four days before the card. Best known for five PFL fights: he reached the 2023 PFL Europe lightweight final (stopped by Jakub Kaszuba in R2) and lost a decision to Makkasharip Zaynukov in 2025. He knocked out Kallew dos Santos in 59 seconds in July. He is 2-0 as a pro boxer.

how_they_fight.Striking: A boxer first (2-0 pro boxing): four knockouts in our data, in R1, R2 and R3.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped twice: by Kaszuba (R2 TKO) and by submission (R1).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Five decision wins; goes three rounds comfortably.

patterns: Boxing-led; finishes spread over all three rounds
concerns: Four days' notice for his UFC debut
Stopped by the best opponent he faced (Kaszuba)
keys_to_beat: Pressure him early before he finds his range

news.text: Signed with the UFC and booked against Shoaib Yousaf on four days' notice; he had been due to fight for a BullWaves title on Nov. 27.

sources.title: UFC signs two fighters for late-notice undercard matchup for UFC Qatar
